name: bengali-shaper
description: HarfBuzz-based complex-script text shaping for Bengali PDF content — see courier_waybill_context.md §4.5/§4.7. Renders text to SVG glyph outlines (real OpenType GSUB ligatures + GPOS mark positioning) so dompdf (which has no shaping engine of its own) can embed it as an instead of drawing raw, un-shaped codepoints.
